padding:I2778:127377;145:7579;245:2027.note: The credit balance pill is tighter than the Design on every screen that shows it. Measured on the phone: the coin icon is drawn about 11 pt wide and starts about 10 pt from the pill's left edge (Design: 13.3 pt, 13 pt in), and the number ends about 11 pt from the right edge (Design: about 14 pt). The balance itself (「28787」 against the Design's 「400」) is sample content and is not the issue; the insets and the smaller coin are, and they make the pill look cramped. One fix in the shared pill covers every screen.
padding:I2778:127377;145:7579;245:2027.note_zh: 積分餘額膠囊在每個出現的畫面都比 Design 緊。手機上量到：金幣圖示約 11 pt 寬、距膠囊左緣約 10 pt（Design 為 13.3 pt、內縮 13 pt），數字距右緣約 11 pt（Design 約 14 pt）。餘額數字本身（「28787」對 Design 的「400」）是範例內容，不是問題；問題在內距與縮小的金幣，讓膠囊顯得擠。改共用的膠囊元件即可修正所有畫面。
padding:I2778:127377;145:7579;245:2027.reviewer: The credit pill is drawn tighter than Design on both ends: the coin starts about 10 pt from the pill's left edge (Design 13 pt) and the number ends about 10 pt from the right edge (Design 14 pt), and the coin itself is about 11 pt across instead of 13 pt. The balance number is account data, but the pill hugs its content, so the insets are comparable whatever the number is. The same pill shows on every AI Mini Drama screen with this difference, so one fix covers all of them.
padding:I2778:127377;145:7579;245:2027.reviewer_zh: 點數膠囊兩端都比 Design 緊：硬幣圖示距膠囊左緣約 10 pt（Design 為 13 pt），數字距右緣約 10 pt（Design 為 14 pt），硬幣本身約 11 pt 寬（Design 為 13 pt）。餘額數字是帳號資料，但膠囊會隨內容縮放，所以不論數字為何內距都可比較。AI Mini Drama 每個畫面上的同一顆膠囊都有這個差異，修一次即可全部修正。

padding:I3172:101306;2750:25393.note: The 「Generate」 button has more space around its word than the Design calls for: about 19 pt from the letters to each side against the Design's 17 pt. The Design draws a button that hugs its word with 16 pt padding left and right (96 × 34 pt on iOS). On Android the word is set in Roboto, which is narrower (letters 54 pt wide against 62 pt), so a button keeping 16 pt padding would be about 88–89 pt wide; the app's button is 92.6 × 33 pt, about 4 pt wider than that, i.e. about 2 pt of extra padding each side. The button still reads close to the Design (3.4 pt narrower than the iOS drawing), so this is cosmetic: RD may set the side padding to 16 pt (or drop a minimum width, if one is set) to match.
padding:I3172:101306;2750:25393.note_zh: 「Generate」按鈕文字兩側的留白比設計稿多：字到左右邊緣約 19 pt，設計稿約 17 pt。設計稿的按鈕寬度隨文字調整，左右內距 16 pt（iOS 上為 96 × 34 pt）。Android 使用 Roboto 字型，同一個字較窄（字寬 54 pt，設計稿 62 pt），若維持 16 pt 內距，按鈕應約 88–89 pt 寬；App 的按鈕為 92.6 × 33 pt，比此寬約 4 pt，即每側多約 2 pt 內距。按鈕整體看起來仍接近設計稿（比 iOS 圖窄 3.4 pt），屬外觀細節：RD 可將左右內距改為 16 pt（若有設定最小寬度則移除）以符合設計稿。
padding:I3172:101306;2750:25393.reviewer: The drawn blue 「Generate」 button is 92.6 x 33.3 pt on the phone against Figma's 96 x 34 pt, and the word sits centred in it (19.4 pt left, 19.1 pt right; 11.5 pt top, 12.1 pt bottom). The extra 2 pt a side comes from the word itself: Android's Roboto sets 「Generate」 54.1 pt wide where Figma's SF Pro draws it 61.7 pt, while the button stays close to Figma's size. The button looks as designed, so this is not a padding problem.
padding:I3172:101306;2750:25393.reviewer_zh: 手機上實際畫出的藍色「Generate」按鈕為 92.6 x 33.3 pt，Figma 為 96 x 34 pt，文字在按鈕中置中（左 19.4 pt、右 19.1 pt；上 11.5 pt、下 12.1 pt）。每側多出的約 2 pt 來自文字本身：Android 的 Roboto 字型把「Generate」排成 54.1 pt 寬，Figma 的 SF Pro 則為 61.7 pt，而按鈕大小仍接近 Figma。按鈕外觀與設計一致，不屬於內距問題。

padding:I2778:128903;1037:48645;245:2027.note_zh: 積分餘額膠囊在每個出現的畫面都比 Design 緊。手機上量到：金幣圖示約 11 pt 寬、距膠囊左緣約 10 pt（Design 為 13.3 pt、內縮 13 pt），數字距右緣約 11 pt（Design 約 14 pt）。餘額數字本身（「28787」對 Design 的「400」）是範例內容，不是問題；問題在內距與縮小的金幣，讓膠囊顯得擠。改共用的膠囊元件即可修正所有畫面。
padding:I2778:128903;1037:48645;245:2027.reviewer: The credit pill is drawn tighter than Design on both ends: the coin starts about 10 pt from the pill's left edge (Design 13 pt) and the number ends about 10 pt from the right edge (Design 14 pt), and the coin itself is about 11 pt across instead of 13 pt. The same pill shows on every AI Mini Drama screen with this difference, so one fix covers all of them.
padding:I2778:128903;1037:48645;245:2027.reviewer_zh: 點數膠囊兩端都比 Design 緊：硬幣圖示距膠囊左緣約 10 pt（Design 為 13 pt），數字距右緣約 10 pt（Design 為 14 pt），硬幣本身約 11 pt 寬（Design 為 13 pt）。餘額數字是帳號資料，但膠囊會隨內容縮放，所以不論數字為何內距都可比較。AI Mini Drama 每個畫面上的同一顆膠囊都有這個差異，修一次即可全部修正。

padding:I2778:128717;1037:48645;245:2027.note: The balance number in the 「credit」 pill sits about 6 pt nearer the coin icon and about 2 pt nearer the right edge than the Design draws (Design: 32 pt from the pill's left edge to the number, 12 pt on the right; app: 26 pt and about 10 pt). The gap between the coin and the number shrinks to about 5 pt, so a five-digit balance looks cramped; the larger sample balance does not explain it, since the pill hugs its number and the insets should stay the same. Same pill on every chat screen of the feature: one fix covers them all.
padding:I2778:128717;1037:48645;245:2027.note_zh: 「credit」膠囊裡的餘額數字比 Design 更靠近金幣圖示約 6 pt、靠右邊緣約 2 pt（Design：膠囊左緣到數字 32 pt、右側 12 pt；App：26 pt 與約 10 pt）。金幣與數字的間距縮到約 5 pt，五位數餘額看起來很擠；這不是樣本數字較長造成的，膠囊包住數字，內距應維持不變。功能內每個對話畫面的同一顆膠囊都一樣，修一處即全部修正。
padding:I2778:128717;1037:48645;245:2027.reviewer: The credit pill is tighter than Design: Design pads it 12 pt on both sides with a 16 pt credit icon and a 4 pt gap, so the number starts 32 pt from the left edge and ends 12 pt from the right; the app uses 9 pt start and 10 pt end padding and a 14 pt icon, so the number sits about 6 pt nearer the left edge and 2 pt nearer the right. The balance number itself is sample content; the padding and icon size are not. Same pill on every chat screen, dark and light.
padding:I2778:128717;1037:48645;245:2027.reviewer_zh: 點數膠囊比 Design 緊：Design 左右內距各 12 pt、點數圖示 16 pt、間距 4 pt，所以數字距左緣 32 pt、距右緣 12 pt；App 起始內距 9 pt、結尾 10 pt、圖示 14 pt，數字離左緣近約 6 pt、離右緣近約 2 pt。餘額數字本身是範例內容，內距與圖示大小不是。所有聊天畫面（深色與淺色）的點數膠囊都一樣。
